task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
The video shows a close-up underwater view of a heavily encrusted, vertical metal structure, likely a shipwreck or artificial reef, set against a bright blue water background. The structure is covered in a thick, textured layer of marine growth, including white and pale green coralline algae, sponges, and patches of yellowish-brown soft coral or gorgonians. The camera tilts upward along the structure, revealing its height and the dense colonization of its surfaces. Small, dark fish swim in the open water to the left of the structure, and a single, larger, pale-colored fish is visible on the right side in the later frames. The lighting is bright and diffuse, typical of shallow, clear water, causing some overexposure on the upper parts of the encrustation. The overall scene is static except for the camera movement and the swimming fish.

The overall scene is static except for the camera movement and the swimming fish.

The video shows a close-up underwater view of a heavily encrusted, vertical metal structure, likely a shipwreck or artificial reef, set against a bright blue water background. The lighting is bright and diffuse, typical of shallow, clear water, causing some overexposure on the upper parts of the encrustation. The overall scene is static except for the camera movement and the swimming fish.

The video shows a close-up underwater view of a heavily encrusted, vertical metal structure, likely a shipwreck or artificial reef, set against a bright blue water background.
